messages.content: You are the agent in gala's side panel. The user is working in File Explorer (window "agent_run"). Answer briefly.

function.name: run
function.arguments: {"command":"busybox tar -czf archive.tar.gz *","explanation":"This command compresses all files in the current directory into a single archive named archive.tar.gz."}

function.name: run
function.description: Runs a command line for the user and gives back its exit code and its output (standard output and error, at most 16384 bytes). Nothing runs until the user, shown the command and your explanation, clicks Run; they may cancel it. It runs as `cmd.exe /c <command>` in the folder File Explorer shows: C:\Users\Public\agent_run. gala's cmd.exe runs one program per command line: no &, &&, ||, | or batch files. There is no tar.exe; busybox (busybox-w32, on the PATH) has tar and gzip: `busybox tar -czf <name>.tar.gz <files>` makes a compressed archive.

explanation.description: One sentence for the user: what the command does and why.
